summary: Staging storage bucket found publicly listable during a config review. It held synthetic test data only; access closed within 20 minutes.
Support agent account accessed from an unrecognised location; agent can view customer tickets.
Credential stuffing on one agent account; 412 customer tickets viewed, 37 belonging to EU customers.
Agent sessions revoked, password reset, MFA enforced for all support accounts.
Art. 33 notification filed within 72 hours for the 37 EU data subjects.
All affected customers emailed in plain language with what was seen and steps to take. Doubles as a DPDP Rule 7(1) drill.
